info.title: School Management API
info.description: Comprehensive API documentation for School Management System including Authentication, Drivers, Attenders, Students, Student Details, Dashboard, and System Health endpoints.

servers.description: Current Server (Auto /api - Recommended for all hosts)

tags.name: Authentication & API Keys
tags.description: Endpoints for user authentication and API key management.

tags.name: Attender Management
tags.description: Endpoints for managing transport attenders. Requires X-API-Key: attender-api-secret-key-2026

tags.name: Boarding Point Tracking
tags.description: Endpoints for managing student bus boarding records with student details, grade, address, search, and filtering.

tags.name: Bus Live Location
tags.description: Real-time GPS tracking and telemetry endpoints for school buses. Used by the Flutter driver app to push live coordinates and parents/admin apps to track buses.

tags.name: Dashboard
tags.description: Dashboard API returning Bus details, Route details, and Student transport status (Total, Boarded, Dropped, Pending) under a single API key: dashboard-api-secret-key-2026

tags.name: Driver Management
tags.description: Endpoints for managing transport drivers. Requires X-API-Key: driver-api-secret-key-2026

tags.name: Route Management
tags.description: Endpoints for managing and retrieving school transport routes, assigned buses (vehicles), and pickup points. Requires X-API-Key or Bearer token.

tags.name: Trip Management
tags.description: Endpoints for starting, tracking, and completing bus transit trips by drivers/attenders in the Flutter app.

tags.name: Student Details Management
tags.description: Endpoints for searching, viewing, registering student details, and managing student boarding & drop status (Pending, Boarded, Dropped). Requires X-API-Key: student-details-api-secret-key-2026

tags.name: Users
tags.description: User related endpoints for the API.

post.description: Authenticates a staff/admin, student, or parent user and returns the login token and user session.

get.description: Retrieves API keys used by Driver, Attender, Studentdetails, Dashboard and system admin requests.
Retrieves list of all transport attenders.

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing API key

get.description: Retrieves details of a specific attender by ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Attender ID

delete.description: Removes an attender record by ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Attender ID to delete

post.summary: Record live bus location and GPS telemetry
post.description: Receives live GPS coordinates (latitude, longitude), speed, heading, and timestamp for a bus during an active trip. Includes trip-based details in the response.

bus_id.description: Bus identifier, vehicle ID, or registration number

speed.description: Speed in km/h (helps parents know if bus is moving)

heading.description: Direction in degrees (0-360) so the icon rotates on the map

201.description: Bus location recorded successfully with trip details

400.description: Validation error - bus_id, latitude, and longitude are required

get.summary: Get latest live location for a bus or trip
get.description: Retrieves the most recent GPS coordinates, speed, heading, and trip info for a given bus_id or trip_id.

parameters.name: bus_id
parameters.description: Bus / Vehicle ID to retrieve latest location for

parameters.name: trip_id
parameters.description: Trip ID to retrieve latest location for

200.description: Latest bus location and telemetry retrieved successfully

404.description: No location recorded yet for this bus or trip

get.summary: Get all boarding records with filters
get.description: Retrieves list of student bus boarding records with student name, grade, address, vehicle, and attender details. Supports filtering by status, busid, attenderid, studentid, date, and keyword search.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status (pending, boarded, deboarded, dropped)

parameters.name: busid
parameters.description: Filter by Bus/Vehicle ID

parameters.name: attenderid
parameters.description: Filter by Attender ID

parameters.name: studentid
parameters.description: Filter by Student ID

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Filter by record date (YYYY-MM-DD)

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by student name, admission no, roll no, grade, vehicle no, attender name, or address

get.description: Retrieves details of a specific boarding record by ID including student info, grade, and address.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Boarding record ID

post.description: Creates a new boarding entry for a student with status (pending, boarded, deboarded, dropped). Bus ID is optional (defaults to student's assigned bus or 0 if unassigned).

400.description: Required fields missing: studentid, attenderid or invalid status

busid.description: Bus ID (optional/nullable, defaults to student's assigned bus or 0 if unassigned)

post.description: Updates the status (pending, boarded, deboarded, dropped) of a boarding record by ID or studentid.

studentid.description: Student ID (if ID is not provided)

status.description: New status value (pending, boarded, deboarded, dropped)

delete.description: Removes a boarding record by ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Boarding record ID to delete

get.summary: Get Dashboard summary (Bus details, Route details, Student boarding stats)
get.description: Retrieves complete dashboard overview including bus details, route details, total students, total students boarded, total students dropped, and total pending students in a single response.

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing API key

parameters.name: api_key
parameters.description: API Key for authentication. Defaults to dashboard-api-secret-key-2026 if omitted.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Date for attendance/boarding stats (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

parameters.name: route_id
parameters.description: Filter dashboard data by specific Route ID

parameters.name: vehicle_id
parameters.description: Filter dashboard data by specific Vehicle ID

get.description: Retrieves list of all transport drivers.

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing API key

get.description: Retrieves details of a specific driver by ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Driver ID

delete.description: Removes a driver record by ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Driver ID to delete

get.description: Returns a simple success response to confirm the API is reachable.
Returns the current API status and environment details.

get.summary: Get transport routes with vehicle and pickup point details
get.description: Retrieves school transport routes matching the admin route management page (/admin/route). Supports filtering by route_id, vehicle_id (or bus_id), and pickup_point_id.

200.description: List of routes and assigned pickup points retrieved successfully

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing authentication token / API key

parameters.name: bus_number
parameters.description: Bus Number / Vehicle Number from auth login (e.g. "KL 38 M 0990", "KL 17 Y 8989"). Alias: bus_no, vehicle_no

parameters.name: vehicle_id
parameters.description: Vehicle / Bus ID (e.g. 2, 5) or Bus Number. Alias: vehicleid, bus_id, busid

parameters.name: route_id
parameters.description: Route ID (optional, not required). Alias: routeid, id

parameters.name: pickup_point_id
parameters.description: Filter routes by Pickup Point ID (optional). Alias: pickuppointid

parameters.name: pickup_point_name
parameters.description: Filter routes by Pickup Point Name (optional). Case-insensitive search.

get.summary: Get routes by specific bus ID
get.description: Retrieves all routes, assigned bus details, driver, attender, and pickup points for a specific bus ID.

200.description: Routes for the specified bus retrieved successfully

parameters.name: bus_id
parameters.description: Bus / Vehicle ID (e.g. 3, 5)

get.summary: Get single route details by route ID
get.description: Retrieves full details of a specific route including assigned bus and pickup points by route ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Route ID (optional)

post.description: Creates and starts a new trip for a bus and route. Returns the created trip_id.

bus_id.description: Bus / Vehicle ID or Bus Number

trip_type.description: Trip type: pickup or drop (default: pickup)

post.description: Marks a trip as completed with end_time.

get.summary: Get trip status or active trip
get.description: Gets trip status by trip_id, or finds the active trip by bus_id.

parameters.name: trip_id
parameters.description: Trip ID

parameters.name: bus_id
parameters.description: Bus / Vehicle ID to find currently active trip

get.summary: Get students list with attendance status and summary counts
get.description: Retrieves a list of students with grade, address, boarding status (Pending, Boarded, Dropped), and summary counts.

200.description: List of students and status summary retrieved successfully

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing API key

parameters.name: class_id
parameters.description: Filter by Class ID

parameters.name: section_id
parameters.description: Filter by Section ID

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max number of records

get.description: Retrieves full details of a specific student by student ID or parent phone number (parent login check without token).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Student ID, Admission No, or Roll No

parameters.name: student_id
parameters.description: Alias for student ID

parameters.name: parent_phone
parameters.description: Parent phone number for parent login check without token

get.summary: Get latest boarding point and transport info
get.description: Retrieves the latest boarding point record for a student, along with assigned route, pickup point, bus information, driver, and attender details by student ID and parent phone number.

200.description: Latest student boarding point and transport info retrieved successfully

parameters.name: student_id
parameters.description: Student ID, Admission No, or Roll No

parameters.name: phone_number
parameters.description: Parent phone number (guardian, father, mother, or student mobile)

post.summary: Update student boarding status (Mark Boarded / Mark Dropped)
post.description: Updates student boarding status. Accepts student_id (or admission_no) and action ("Mark Boarded", "Mark Dropped", "Mark Pending") or status ("Boarded", "Dropped", "Pending").
Searches students by name, admission number, or roll number.
Registers a new student record into the system.
Registers a new student into the school management system.

Returns a single user by id.

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: API Key authentication via X-API-Key header (e.g. driver-api-secret-key-2026, attender-api-secret-key-2026, student-details-api-secret-key-2026, dashboard-api-secret-key-2026, system-admin-api-key-2026)
